source_citation: Zhang et al. (2020), Seasonal and Interannual Variability of the Currents off the New Guinea Coast From Mooring Measurements, doi:10.1029/2020JC016242.
source_access: Publisher abstract, Introduction, Data and Method, sections 3.1–3.3 and figure captions read. No figure, velocity field or axis digitized.
scope: Local alongshore direction at the 141.4 E, 1.7 S mooring; monthly composite of three cycles, with interannual contamination and instrument gaps. Not a whole-current monthly path.
sampling_note: Data above 30 m removed; upper-400 m instrument outage July 2016–March 2017. Monthly averages; three cycles provide limited independence.
interpretation: November–April southeastward and May–October northwestward describe the short-record composite. In the 2015/2016 El Niño interval the eastward NGCC disappears as NGCUC shoals. Exception is selectable separately and excluded from seasonal playback.

phases.layer: Upper-100 m NGCC context; ADCP measurements above 30 m excluded. No uniform layer assigned along a route.
